title: Mapstead — Store Locator
objective: Searches go through the app's own server. Call the upstream geocoding API directly, as if you were the app itself.

verifier.condition: The upstream geocoding endpoint is called directly using the API key found in a static asset.

weakness: A local-development configuration file containing the upstream API key was left in the production build and served as a public static asset, although the app's own search feature never needs the client to hold that key.
seededData: A store-locator page that loads two script files. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Can search for stores through the app normally.

hints: The search box works by calling the app's own server. Look at everything else the page loads besides that call.
Not every script on a page is there to add behavior — some just hold values.
Find the upstream endpoint's own address and call it with the key straight from the config file.
burpNotes: List every file the locator page requests and read each one, not just the one that handles clicks.
